scope: Final retrieval configuration freeze after the one bounded Week 11 temporal-ordering test; no further retrieval changes are permitted.

ildc_single.known_limitation: ILDC decision dates are year-granular; strict precedent filtering uses eCourts exact decision dates.

cleaned_corpus_identity.identity_scope: Final local cleaned JSONL corpus. This identifies the cleaned corpus bytes but is not an immutable upstream S3 snapshot or PostgreSQL volume dump.

reconstructed_model.note: Deterministic reconstruction from frozen C=10.0 train+validation inputs; its hash is frozen for verification.

checkpoint_6318.note: Checkpoint weights remain gitignored by design because of size; their SHA-256 values are tracked here for verification before replay or inference.

discarded_256_token_prefix.reason: 256-token cap; 1491/1503 (99.20%) eligible test inputs were truncated.

model.head_initialization: AutoModelForSequenceClassification with a new randomly initialized two-label classification head

answer_renderer.input_contract: Accept only the Week 7 selected, temporally eligible evidence candidates and the user query; never retrieve, rank, infer, or add authorities.
answer_renderer.grounding_rule: Every material legal statement is an exact selected-evidence passage with its stable provenance. The conclusion is frozen non-inferential boilerplate tied only to the displayed evidence IDs; static labels and uncertainty wording are non-material boilerplate. When no eligible evidence is selected, output no authority and state the insufficiency explicitly.
disallowed_output: citations absent from the supplied evidence
same-year, later, missing-date, or query-duplicate evidence
answer_renderer.uncertainty_text: This is an evidence-grounded research brief, not legal advice. It reports only the selected retrieved passages and does not infer conclusions beyond them. Missing or incomplete evidence should be reviewed by a human.

citation_verifier.input_contract: A Week 8 controlled answer together with its retrieval run ID, query ID, query year, and persisted corpus provenance.
required_checks: case citation resolves to an existing corpus chunk
displayed passage and provenance exactly match the corpus record
chunk was recorded in the retrieval run for this query
candidate is neither an exact target-case nor an audited near duplicate
candidate decision year is strictly earlier than the ILDC query year
citation_verifier.answer_key_measurement: For test-split queries, reconcile expected authorities using the verified authority source ID, citation, or title plus exact decision date when the corpus stores a parallel reporter citation. Record retrieved-but-not-selected authorities separately from authorities absent from the retrieved candidates, and displayed citations that fail verification.
citation_verifier.unsupported_citation_policy: The controlled E3 renderer emits corpus case citations only. Any citation without a linked evidence chunk, including an unsupported case-name field, is rejected; statutes or other source types are not silently treated as verified.

retrieval_selection.query_construction: deterministic TF-IDF salient-term extraction over the full frozen facts-only text: segment by sentence/paragraph, remove procedural-report boilerplate, score unigrams by segment TF-IDF with a mild within-document frequency factor, retain section/article cues, and select at most 32 unique terms
retrieval_selection.legacy_query_construction: legacy-first-32-terms-v1 (retained only to reproduce the Week 9 final regression)
retrieval_selection.eligibility_requirement: strictly earlier decision year; applied to the BM25 candidate relation before ORDER BY/LIMIT 100
retrieval_selection.redundancy_rule: select at most one chunk per source_id
retrieval_selection.ordering: descending BM25 score; retain original retrieval rank as deterministic tie-breaker
retrieval_selection.direct_content_self_match_rule: Exclude a content self-match only when at least 100 six-token phrase occurrences overlap and at least 80% of the candidate source's unique six-token fingerprints occur in the query case. This preserves true self-copy protection while retaining an earlier authority substantially quoted in a later query judgment.
retrieval_selection.rationale: A small, source-diverse evidence set is easier to inspect and reduces adjacent-passage duplication without adding a learned reranker. The final bounded temporal-ordering test applies the existing strict earlier-year rule before BM25 ranking so future and same-year documents cannot consume the top-100 depth. On the 30-case frozen answer-key cohort it improved Recall@5 from 5/30 to 12/30, Recall@100 from 12/30 to 15/30, and expected authorities selected from 11/30 to 12/30, with no regression among the original 12 retrieval successes. No further retrieval configuration changes are permitted.

query_builder_final_regression.method_comparison: legacy_first_32 versus salient_tfidf on six pre-specified real answer-key controls at k=100 and k=500, using identical full facts-only inputs and the unchanged BM25 index/safety filters.
query_builder_final_regression.decision_basis: After the direct self-match false-positive repair, salient terms were non-worsening on all six controls and retrieved/selected 2008_1629, 1995_425, and 2002_944 at ranks 1, 1, and 6. No further query-construction variation is permitted after this check.

dev_probe_selfmatch_recheck.interpretation: The pre-fix broad lexical-mismatch conclusion is withdrawn: the self-match rule was a material contributor. The corrected configuration retrieves 6/9 expected authorities at k=100 and 7/9 at k=500; newly retrieved after the repair are 1984_62, 1988_238, 1992_137. Only the remaining absent cases are residual retrieval failures, not evidence for a corpus-wide lexical-mismatch claim.

E4.temporal_policy: precedent_decision_year < ildc_query_year; same-year is ambiguous and excluded; missing decision date is excluded.
E4.duplicate_policy: Exclude alignment-gated target/near-case source IDs. Direct text self-match additionally requires at least 100 shared six-token phrase occurrences and 80% unique source-phrase coverage, preventing a quoted earlier authority from being treated as the query case.

environment.database_url_source: LEGAL_XAI_DATABASE_URL environment variable or scripts/load_provenance.py default; credentials are intentionally not frozen in the repository.

host_replay_environment.role: The Week 16 clean-checkout E2 inference replay used the host environment and reproduced the frozen checkpoint metrics exactly.

E2_training_image.role: The frozen E2 checkpoint was trained under this Dockerfile's pinned training dependency set.

transformers_runtime_roles.resolution: The two versions coexist by role, not as an unresolved dependency conflict: 4.46.3 identifies the original E2 training container, while host 5.15.0 is the later replay environment that exactly reproduced its inference output. Re-pinning the host at this late frozen stage is unnecessary and could destabilize the verified replay.

container_image_policy.scope: local research deployment, not production infrastructure
container_image_policy.mutable_tag_limitation: The PostgreSQL service, OCR base image (python:3.11-slim), and E2 base image (pytorch/pytorch:2.5.1-cuda12.4-cudnn9-runtime) are recorded as tags. The observed PostgreSQL digest is included above, but external base-image tags are not pinned to digests. This is an accepted limitation for the frozen local research workflow; the Dockerfile/compose hashes and last build-definition commit identify the build instructions, not an immutable remote image snapshot.

replay_contract.comparison: Two independent E4 runs must match after excluding generated retrieval run IDs; selected chunks, answer structure, citations, temporal counts, and provenance must be identical.
